title: How Relationships Shape Your Career Journey
text: Understanding the power of mentors and role models, how positive relationships open doors, why networks matter in future careers, identifying people who inspire you, and exploring how connections create opportunities.
cdi_links: 4.C.01 Developing friendships and relationships and reflecting on their relationship to their career

title: Introduction
bullets: People around us influence our confidence, ambitions, and opportunities
Friends, family, teachers, coaches, and role models shape career thinking
Building positive connections is a powerful skill for career development
Young people already have networks that can guide, motivate, and open doors

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can identify people who influence my career thinking
I can explain how mentors and role models guide choices
I can explain how networks and connections create opportunities
I can describe how positive relationships support my goals

title: Key Words
bullets: Mentorship – Guidance from someone more experienced to help you grow
Networking – Building connections with people who can support your career
Career Influence – The way people and relationships shape your career choices

title: Starter Activity – Who Helps You Grow?
bullets: Who do you look up to or admire?
How have they influenced your choices or ideas about the future?
Can you think of a situation where someone’s advice or support opened up an opportunity for you?

title: Building Opportunities Through Relationships
bullets: Friends, family, teachers, mentors, and colleagues provide guidance, encouragement, and open doors
Mentors advise, support, and guide you in making career decisions
Networking involves building connections with people who can support your career
Strong networks help you discover job/training opportunities, gain advice, and build a reputation

title: Positive Relationships in Action
bullets: Being proactive: reach out, ask questions, offer help
Representing yourself well: show respect, reliability, and enthusiasm
Learning from others: observe, listen, and adapt
Building and maintaining relationships creates opportunities for your future

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Relationships influence confidence, career thinking, and opportunities
Mentors and role models guide choices and provide advice
Networking creates opportunities and helps build a professional reputation
Proactive engagement and strong interpersonal skills are essential for success
